tools.name: apply_patch_vehicle
tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. Use for ANY change: set a component property, add/remove a component, reorder components, or create/edit an equation parameter. component_name must be an existing component. key selects which field; only use keys listed in the enum.

component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.name: describe_vehicle
tools.description: Read the current design as an inventory of components and their properties. Call before deciding what to change.

tools.name: describe_parameters
tools.description: Read the document-level Parameters block: each parameter name, its literal or equation value, and its computed value.

tools.name: library_list
tools.description: List saved library components (names, kinds, dimensions). Useful to reuse a standard part or insert one.

query.description: Optional search term to filter by name/tag. Empty to list all.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.description: List saved library components (names, kinds, dimensions). Useful to reuse a standard part or insert one.

query.description: Optional search term to filter by name/tag. Empty to list all.

tools.name: apply_patch_vehicle
tools.description: Apply a single structured Patch to the current RON design document. Use for ANY change: set a component property, add/remove a component, reorder components, or create/edit an equation parameter. component_name must be an existing component. key selects which field; only use keys listed in the enum.

component_name.description: Exact component name from the document, e.g. 'Nose' or 'Body'.

operation.description: Which Patch kind. SetProperty edits one field of one component. SetParameter creates/edits a document-level equation parameter.

key.description: Which property to change. Set to property name directly.

value.description: New value as a string: a number ('300.0'), a color ('red'/'#ff8800'), a material ('Al-6061-T6'), a bool ('true'), or an equation when key is a parameter name. Use trailing .0 for floats.

tools.name: describe_vehicle
tools.description: Read the current design as an inventory of components and their properties. Call before deciding what to change.
